Based on the data provided, here are some software products and their End-of-Life (EOS) information:

**Windows Server 2022**
*   **EOS Date:** 2031-10-14
*   **Support Tiers:**
    *   Mainstream Support ends: 2026-10-13
    *   Extended Support ends: 2031-10-14

**MS SQL Server 2019 / MS SQL Server Database 2019**
*   **EOS Date:** 2030-01-08
*   **Support Tiers:**
    *   Mainstream Support ends: 2025-02-28
    *   Extended Support ends: 2030-01-08

**CISCO IOS XE Products**
*   **CISCO IOS XE 17.15 (EOS):** 2029-03-31
    *   Last Date of Support: 2029-03-31
*   **CISCO IOS XE 17.12.05a (EOS):** 2028-03-31
    *   Last Date of Support: 2028-03-31

**VMware ESXi 8**
*   **EOS Date:** 2027-10-11
*   **Support Tiers:**
    *   General Support ends: 2027-10-11
    *   Technical Guidance ends: 2029-10-11

**Oracle GoldenGate 19c**
*   **EOS Date:** 2027-04-30
*   **Support Tiers:**
    *   Extended Support ends: 2027-04-30

**Cisco UCCX 12.5.1**
*   **EOS Date:** 2027-12-31
*   **Last Date of Support:** 2027-12-31
